document: National Building Regulations of Iran, Topic 4: General Building Requirements
issuing_authority: Ministry of Roads and Urban Development, Office of National Building Regulations

evidence_records.requirement: A continuous, safe and unobstructed route must connect usable building areas, including usable basements, to a safe open space or public way.
evidence_records.applicability: building access and egress routes; coordinate with Topic 3
evidence_records.provenance: primary regulation text, ministry-issued document; indexed legal publication used for retrieval

evidence_records.requirement: In large parking facilities, provide a pedestrian walkway beside the vehicular aisle or parking spaces, separated by floor-color change or raised floor.
evidence_records.provenance: primary regulation text, ministry-issued document; indexed legal publication used for retrieval

evidence_records.requirement: Large and medium parking facilities must have at least two pedestrian exits compliant with Topic 3.
evidence_records.provenance: primary regulation text, ministry-issued document; indexed legal publication used for retrieval

explicit_non_findings: No authoritative general minimum numeric separation between a pedestrian frontage gate and a vehicle frontage gate was established by this in-scope audit.
The 0.60 m value is a walkway width for large parking facilities, not a frontage gate-to-gate separation distance.
